source_restriction: Doc24 Raw + components only; no GT, no Raw+wires, no OCR engines
review_notes: Raw schematic was treated as authoritative; detected-components overlay and crops were used only as placement/label aids.
Solid lines were extracted as power or DC power; dashed lines as control/trip; dotted lines as signal; black dots were treated as junctions.
Series feeder branches from BUS-201A/B were represented as adjacent component edges through CB, DS, MCC, TB, and the visible load.
Lower feeder control rows were represented as adjacent HS/relay dashed connections plus MCC-to-relay drops where visible.
Central tie/load-shed paths with unclear endpoints were either assigned low/medium confidence when a visible segment reached both objects, or moved to uncertain_edges.
